body.name: Root-ordered sparse-core extendability handle
body.construction: Start from each \(c\in\mathfrak C\); project maximal deterministic directed reachability outside \(X\); order the roots in \(A_c\); branch only on uncertain edges assigned to the first root whose current reachability obligation they privately satisfy; query whether a partial support extends to a support not dominated by a completed support from any core; and recompute the canonical ID failure label only when a support is emitted.
